items: KO's gross margin rose from 60.3% in FY2021 to 61.6% in FY2025, while PEP's moved from 53.3% to 54.1% over the same span.
KO's operating margin dipped to 21.2% in FY2024 and then rose to 28.7% in FY2025. PEP's operating margin went from 14.0% in FY2024 to 12.2% in FY2025.
KO's net margin was 27.3% in FY2025 and PEP's was 8.8%. PEP's net margin had been 10.4% in FY2024.
KO's diluted EPS rose from $2.46 in FY2024 to $3.04 in FY2025. PEP's fell from $6.95 to $6.00.

KO's free cash flow was $5.3B in FY2025, down from $11.3B in FY2021, on revenue of $47.9B. PEP's was $7.7B on revenue of $93.9B. PEP reports R&D of $839M (0.9% of revenue), and KO does not report R&D.

Coca-Cola vs PepsiCo: what each keeps of a revenue dollar

Gross, operating and net margins for KO and PEP, FY2021 to FY2025, with free cash flow and diluted EPS for context.

Dollars, by fiscal year, FY2021 to FY2025.

Diluted EPS

Per-share, by fiscal year; share counts differ between the two.

All margins by year

Data notes

KO fiscal years end 12-31; PEP fiscal years end on 12-27 for FY2025. R&D is n/r for KO in every year; PEP R&D is 0.9% of revenue each year, FY2021 to FY2025. Cash runway is n/m for both. No cost-of-sales split is reported in the data, so gross, operating and net margin stand in for where revenue goes.

Takeaways

  • KO's gross margin moved from 58.1% in FY2022 to 61.6% in FY2025; PEP's moved from 53.0% to 54.1%.
  • KO's operating margin was 21.2% in FY2024 and 28.7% in FY2025, while PEP's went from 14.0% to 12.2%.
  • Net margin went from 25.3% to 27.3% at KO (FY2021 to FY2025) and from 9.6% to 8.8% at PEP.
  • Free cash flow went from $11.3B in FY2021 to $5.3B in FY2025 at KO, and from $7.0B to $7.7B at PEP.
  • Diluted EPS went from $2.25 to $3.04 at KO and from $5.49 to $6.00 at PEP, which peaked at $6.95 in FY2024.

Not financial advice.

Source: each company's 10-K filings, FY2021 to FY2025.
